title: A progress note, not a report
intro: A checkpoint is what the next worker would need if you stopped now. It is capped in length on purpose: past the cap you are writing a handover, and it says so.

scenarios.title: Recording progress
scenarios.explain: The file is written atomically at mode 0600 and is never staged. Its name carries the timestamp, branch and head, so a record can be placed without opening it.

scenarios.title: With no active task
scenarios.explain: A checkpoint belongs to a task. Writing one with nothing to attach it to would produce a record that no later reader could place.
